scope: Engine strengthening Phase 1: E01, E02, E03, E20 only
baseline: 327 unit tests passed before changes; substantial existing uncommitted work retained

items.existing: Intelligence event JSON and job status
items.observed_issue: No shared foundation result contract
items.consequence: Execution success can be confused with sufficient evidence
items.fix: Strict foundation/1 contract with separate execution, completeness, severity, review and structured issue categories
items.verification: test_execution_completeness_severity_and_review_are_independent; integration blocked approval

items.existing: RuleVersion/RuleAction registry and published-version resolver
items.observed_issue: Selection explanation absent; published records were not rechecked for source verification
items.consequence: Selection policy and content attestation not visible at execution
items.fix: Return date basis and published-version selection policy; reject selection if validation blockers exist
items.verification: regulatory evaluation unit tests; regulatory workflow integration tests

items.existing: Authority, URL, provision, retrieved date/hash, effective dates
items.observed_issue: No explicit source category or publication date
items.consequence: Guidance and legislation could be conflated
items.fix: Optional typed source category, publication date, topic and implementation reference; absent legacy metadata stays unknown
items.verification: Pydantic validation and regulatory regression tests

items.existing: Same-key reviewed amendments, country/framework binding and predicates
items.observed_issue: No general cross-key legal conflict solver or executable transitional-law language
items.consequence: Conflicts between separate rule keys still require professional resolution
items.fix: Retain explicit same-key selection policy; do not introduce unsupported substantive rules
items.verification: Existing predicate/date-boundary tests; synthetic approved rule assessment

items.existing: Attested source hashes and approved official-domain registry
items.observed_issue: Attestation is not automated verification of legal content
items.consequence: Technical publication cannot establish legal correctness
items.fix: No legal rate or threshold changed; dependent rules require actual retained primary documents and independent content review
items.verification: Synthetic fixtures expressly make no UAE legal attestation

items.existing: Private original versions and SHA-256
items.observed_issue: Repeated identical upload creates a new evidence revision
items.consequence: Unnecessary versions and downstream invalidation
items.fix: Within editable record, reuse current matching hash and scan state; log duplicate detection; historical revert remains a new version
items.verification: Repeated PDF upload returns same version ID in foundation integration test

items.existing: Local PDFium/RapidOCR with retained page/block locations
items.observed_issue: English-only label patterns; Arabic separators unsupported
items.consequence: Arabic labeled evidence fields remain missing
items.fix: Arabic labels, Arabic/Persian digit normalization and Arabic separators; retain original text and null field confidence
items.verification: Arabic/English synthetic labeled-text fixtures, conflicting values, malformed amounts, explicit date conventions

items.existing: Bounded worker process, timeouts, fixed page/byte limits
items.observed_issue: Extraction limits were hardcoded
items.consequence: Deployments cannot tune supported workloads
items.fix: Bounded DOCUMENT_MAX_PAGES and DOCUMENT_MAX_BYTES applied to extraction, preview and capability reporting
items.verification: Real retained digital PDF extraction and configuration contract; new limit boundary unit cases

items.capability: General invoice and Arabic OCR accuracy
items.existing: Local OCR package and pattern-based field extraction
items.observed_issue: No representative Arabic scan evaluation; no general multipage invoice-table extraction or document-type correction workflow
items.consequence: Unsupported evidence must remain human-reviewed; currency symbols are not safely inferred
items.fix: Expose language limitation and do not invent missing fields or confidence
items.verification: Digital PDF and labeled-text tests only; not an Arabic scanned-image accuracy claim

items.existing: ClamAV INSTREAM integration; fail-closed quarantine
items.observed_issue: Operational scanner not established by this test run
items.consequence: Real uploads stay quarantined without configured functioning scanner
items.fix: Keep quarantine; explicitly label test-double scanner in evidence report
items.verification: Existing quarantine tests and foundation CLEAN test double

items.existing: Decimal amounts, staged source rows, immutable snapshots, control totals, idempotent import fingerprints
items.observed_issue: Partial-extract journal imbalance wording implied a ledger error
items.consequence: Incomplete data could be misinterpreted as accounting misstatement
items.fix: Retain activation block but label incomplete-extract limitation; no balancing entries
items.verification: Import pipeline regression tests and explicit partial-extract test

items.existing: Supporting-table reader accepted any three alphabetic characters
items.observed_issue: Invalid codes such as ZZZ pass
items.consequence: Invalid currency can enter supporting schedules
items.fix: Use existing pycountry ISO currency registry
items.verification: Supporting-table invalid-currency unit test

items.existing: FinancialPeriod had only dates
items.observed_issue: Ledger activation and mapping changes remain possible after close
items.consequence: Approved period basis could change silently
items.fix: Migration 0020 adds lock state/version; authorized reasoned lock/reopen; activation serializes on period; entity-wide mapping changes block while any period is locked
items.verification: Unauthorized action, stale lock version, locked import/mapping rejection and reopened activation integration test

items.existing: MappingProfile versions and account mapping receipts; rules_baseline proposal labels
items.observed_issue: General mapping-create API permits authorized caller to mark profile approved; no general independent approval/effective-date taxonomy lifecycle
items.consequence: Foundation mapping approval is existing administrative approval, not new segregation of duties
items.fix: Preserve mapping history and invalidate dependent foundation events on mapping change; lock guard added
items.verification: Mapping-change stale propagation integration test

items.existing: Immutable journal snapshots and explicit superseding imports
items.observed_issue: No new posted-adjustment/reversal lifecycle or automatic comparative-restatement engine in this delivery
items.consequence: Adjustments need existing controlled workpapers and replacement imports
items.fix: Do not fabricate journal adjustments or balancing entries; define source/version receipts for later phases
items.verification: Existing immutable import/supersession checks

items.existing: Intelligence freshness checker
items.observed_issue: Unrecognised receipt types fell through as current
items.consequence: Incompatible provenance could authorize review
items.fix: Fail closed for unknown receipt types and foreign tenants/engagement dependencies
items.verification: Unknown-schema and tenant unit tests; tenant/engagement integration boundaries

items.existing: Recursive UUID reference capture

items.fix: Reject known cross-engagement audit and intelligence references
items.verification: Existing accounting intelligence/workpaper regression checks; dedicated capture isolation test

items.existing: Evidence versions, normalized journal source IDs, immutable intelligence receipts, generated audit working papers

items.consequence: Controls reviewed separately without one source-bound result
items.fix: Existing job operation foundation-validation joins source controls, mappings, field-to-journal links, reviewed extractions and rule assessments
items.verification: Full synthetic HTTP/job/PDF workflow through two-stage working-paper approval, stale release block and replacement approval

items.existing: Audit record version checks, role permissions, independent reviews, recursive read-time freshness
